title: C# Questions & Answers - String Class with Description

description: This set of C# Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on "String Class with Description".

questions.question: What is a string in C#?
questions.explanation: In C#, 'string' is a predefined reference type. When you declare a string, you are creating an object of the 'System.String' class.

questions.question: What does the term 'immutable' mean in term of string objects?

options.text: We can modify characters included in the string
We cannot modify characters contained in the string
We cannot perform operations like comparison or appending

questions.explanation: String objects are immutable, meaning once created, their values cannot be changed. Operations that appear to modify a string actually return a new string object.

questions.question: Which operations are supported for performing comparison on strings in C#?
questions.explanation: C# supports string comparison through the Compare() method, the Equals() method, and the overloaded '==' operator.

questions.question: What will be the output of the following C# code?

questions.question: What is the correct way to convert a string to uppercase in C#?
questions.explanation: The ToUpper() method is an instance method of the String class. Example: s1.ToUpper().
